artworks.title: Si tu ne viens pas plus que ça au collège ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There is a drawing of two individuals in a street setting. The adult is holding the hand of a child. The adult, positioned on the left, has defined facial features including a nose and chin. They are wearing a bowler hat, a suit, and holding a walking stick. The child, on the right, is wearing a striped hat, tunic, pants, and boots. The background shows buildings and streets. The scene is labeled with "LES PAPAS" at the top and has a caption in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Elle a encore ... une jolie taille Madame Coquardeau!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people walking away from the viewer. The central figure wears a head scarf, a knee-length dress, and is mid-stride with her left foot slightly raised. Her face is slightly turned to the right and her hair is short or covered. The person to her left wears a checked outfit, a cap, and is also mid-stride. The person on the far right wears similar attire and all three are in front of a striped floor with columns in the background. The image is done in a sketch style with pencil shading.

artworks.title: Ayant faitartie des muscadins sous le directoire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking side by side in full body view. The man on the left leans slightly forward with his head down, wearing a white top hat and a long coat, with his hands clasped in front of him. His facial features are not clearly detailed. The man on the right stands upright, facing forward, with a stern expression and prominent cheekbones. He is wearing a dark bowler hat, a long coat, and holds a walking stick in his left hand. The background depicts a city street scene with trees on the left and buildings on the right, with a ground of cobblestone.

artworks.title: Vois-tu, c'est l'éclipse qui commence ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking side by side. The man on the left has his arm raised pointing upwards, while the man on the right has his hands in his pockets. The man on the left wears a bowler hat, a scarf, an overcoat, a vest, and striped trousers. The man on the right wears a hat, an overcoat, a scarf, and striped trousers. They are depicted against a cityscape backdrop with tall, narrow buildings under an overcast sky. The ground is cobblestone and there are words written above them.

artworks.title: J'veux a boire! Mais puisque j'vous dis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a half-length view. The man on the left stands behind and slightly to the side of the man on the right, placing a hand on his shoulder. The man on the left has a beard, wears a hat or cap, a long-sleeved shirt rolled up to the elbows, and a waistcoat. The man on the right has disheveled hair, an expression of surprise or pleading, and wears a long coat with visible lapels. He reaches his hand towards glass containers displayed within a shopfront. Beside them on the street, there is a hat on a cobblestone surface. In the background are blurry outlines of buildings, one with a semi-visible sign.

artworks.title: La femme doit suivre son mari ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking across a muddy path. The male figure is walking to the right with a forward stride, while the female figure follows behind with a downward gaze. The man has a pronounced nose and chin and is wearing a tall hat, rolled-up pants, a vest, and shirt, with a coat or jacket slung over his shoulder. He carries an umbrella and a pair of boots tied together. The woman wears a bonnet and a long dress with a shawl, while carrying a woven basket. The background is minimal with a sketched landscape and a large shadow above the figures.

artworks.title: Mon pauvre azor qu'est mort! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two women are depicted from the waist up. The woman on the left is facing the woman on the right, with a hand placed on the other's chest. She wears a white bonnet, a long dress, and a shawl. The woman on the right faces the left, with her body leaning back against a wall or door. She appears surprised or concerned, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. She wears a dark bonnet, a long dress with a high collar. The background is sparsely decorated.

artworks.title: Manière polie de mettre ... a la porte ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in full body profile. The man in the foreground is leaning against a door, his left arm extended, holding it shut. He wears a long coat, pants, and holds a top hat in his other hand. His facial features include a prominent nose and furrowed brow, with gray, tousled hair. Behind him, another man stands, angled towards the first man, playing a violin. He wears a jacket and pants and has disheveled hair. In the background, a textured wall is visible with framed artwork hanging. The image is in monochrome with cross-hatching shading for detail.

artworks.title: Un citoyen exaspéré par les buffleteries
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing on one foot with his body slightly bent backwards. His expression appears surprised or frustrated. He is dressed in a long coat, trousers, and shoes while holding a decorative object above his head. The background is textured, suggesting an indoor setting, and there is text below the illustration.

artworks.title: Deux ex capacité de l'ancien régime
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated on a bench, facing each other in conversation. Both men are wearing formal attire and are set against a backdrop of dense foliage.

artworks.title: Allongeons le pas ... voila ceux hommes ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with figures. The drawing portrays a trio moving quickly along a street. The man is in a top hat and formal attire, holding a walking stick and a child's hand. The woman is dressed in a modest outfit with a bonnet, holding onto the man's arm. Both of them have anxious expressions. In the background, blurred figures wearing similar period clothing are walking in the opposite direction. The setting is an urban street lined with tall, indistinct buildings. The style is characteristic of a satirical or commentary cartoon. The text's title is "Les Alarmistes et Les Alarmés," translating to "The Alarmists and the Alarmed."

artworks.title: M'sieu, c'est une lettre de trois sous ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows a half-body depiction of a person hidden under bed covers, lying on their side in a bed with a worried or surprised expression. The person has wide eyes, short hair, and is wearing night attire. An older woman stands beside the bed, holding up the canopy. She has a profile view, with a prominent nose and chin, and is dressed in a long-sleeved dress with an apron. The background includes the bed, a patterned rug, and lightly outlined vertical lines.

artworks.title: Les maris ne sont pas ce qu'un vain peuple pense!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing two individuals, a woman and a man, in full-length view. The woman is positioned on the left side of the image, standing with her body slightly angled to the right as she extends her right arm outward with her index finger pointing. Her facial features are expressive with her mouth open, and she has dark hair pulled back. She is wearing a long dress with a high neckline and long sleeves. The man stands on the right side with his body facing forward, his hands resting in his pants pockets. He has a more reserved expression with a slight furrowed brow and neat, short hair. He is wearing a formal outfit comprising a jacket and pants, along with a high-collared shirt. The background is illustrated with a simple, textured design featuring floral patterns and vertical lines, adding a decorative element. These patterns suggest an indoor setting.

artworks.title: A.O. Glais-Bizoin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a person in full body view. The figure is standing upright with their hands in their pockets. The person has exaggerated facial features with a large head, prominent cheekbones, and a pronounced chin. They are wearing spectacles and have a receding hairline with short hair. The clothing includes a dark suit jacket, a bow tie, a white shirt, and striped trousers. They are standing on a subtly shaded ground with a lighter background that includes faint sketching of a figure standing at a podium, pointing forward. The text in the image includes the name "Glais-Bizoin" and some descriptive captions.

artworks.title: Achille Tenaille de Vaulabelle
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body caricature of a man in a three-quarter pose. The man has exaggerated facial features including a prominent forehead, bushy eyebrows, and pronounced cheekbones. His hair is sparse and swept to one side. He is dressed in a dark, long coat with tails and vertically striped trousers, holding a wide-brimmed hat in one hand. The background features printed text from a publication with the title "LES REPRESENTANS REPRÉSENTÉS" at the top.

artworks.title: Les amis de la paix ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a physical altercation between two individuals. The scene depicts a struggle between two characters, one of whom is wielding a large object to strike the other. The other character is in a defensive posture, holding onto a cane or stick. The background shows an onlooking crowd. The composition uses contrast and shading, common in satirical illustrations. Text at the bottom alludes to a peace congress and disarmament.

artworks.title: Qu'est la femme aujourd'hui dans la société ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three women are shown from head to toe, standing indoors. The woman on the right is standing on tiptoe, extending her right arm upward, while her left hand holds some papers. Her facial features include a prominent nose and curly hair tied back. She is dressed in a long-sleeved, ankle-length dress with vertical stripes. The woman in the middle is slightly hunched forward and has a bonnet tied around her head. She wears a shawl over her shoulders and is looking in the direction of the woman on the right. The woman on the left is also facing the woman on the right, with her hair tied back into a bun. She wears a blouse with puffed sleeves and a dark long skirt. Her hands are clasped together, and she has a somewhat amused expression. The background suggests vertical wooden planks or a paneled wall, with a small, round pedestal table between the women.

artworks.title: Ma femme reste bien longtemps a ce banquet ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair with his legs crossed, leaning back with one elbow on a table. His head is resting on his hand. He has short, neatly combed hair and a calm facial expression. The man is dressed in a suit with a vest and button-down shirt, and he is not wearing any visible jewelry. Beside him on the floor is a small child sitting against the table's leg, holding a stick and wearing a dress and a large top hat. The background consists of a plain wall with a framed picture hanging on it, and the tabletop is cluttered with a few objects like books and fabric.

artworks.title: Troisième et dernière séance du congrès ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering titled 'Souvenirs du Congrès de la Paix.' The image portrays a chaotic scene with numerous caricature-like figures crowding and seemingly embracing or gesturing exaggeratedly towards one another. The figures are depicted with exaggerated facial features and expressions, creating a sense of comedic absurdity. In the background, there are multiple other figures with indistinct features, emphasizing the crowded nature of the scene. The text at the bottom suggests it is the third and final session of a peace congress.

artworks.title: Le sauvage bineau faisant son entrée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures in a satirical setting. The drawing depicts figures in exaggerated, caricatured form. The upper portion shows a group of five figures, with attention drawn to a central character. The lower portion of the image shows a figure at a podium engaged in a theatrical gesture as another figure looks on. The style of the drawing suggests it captures a particular cultural or historical commentary.

artworks.title: Entrée en classe du jeune Estancelin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatures in a classroom setting. The drawing depicts two classroom scenarios with exaggerated, cartoonish features. In the upper half, titled "Entrée en classe du jeune Estancelin," a small figure walks into a classroom carrying a stool, while others observe and react. In the lower half, labeled "Sortie de la classe," a group of figures are seen leaving through a doorway, engaged in a lively interaction. The style is humorous and illustrative, characterized by caricature and satire.

artworks.title: Fête du 4 Mai
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures arranging flowers in front of a statue. The drawing features exaggerated figures, some wearing garlands or holding out flowers. They seem engaged in a ceremonial activity involving a covered table laden with flowers. In the background, there is a statue on a pedestal, partially obscured by the foreground figures. The setting appears festive yet satirical, evoking a critical or humorous observation of the scene. The caricature style highlights the absurdity or pomp of the scene depicted.

artworks.title: Mac-Adam [sic] et Bineau aux enfers. Par suite d'une punition terrible, mais méritée, ils sont condamnés à repaver les Champs Elysées.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring three caricatured figures in an imagined scenario. Two characters are engaged in laborious tasks under the supervision of a third figure. The central character holds a large rock and appears to be exerting effort, with perspiration visible on his face and clothing. He wears a large hat and has a toiling expression. To the right, another character with a bulbous head shape is depicted using a massive mallet. The background features indistinct forms resembling trees, adding a somber atmosphere. The drawing uses exaggerated features to portray a humorous scene. The style reflects characteristics typical of 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: Ratapoil et Casmajou
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature drawing of two full-body figures facing each other in profile. The person on the left holds a cane, wearing a coat and a high top hat with exaggerated features. The person on the right wears a similar outfit but has a calmer demeanor and smoother facial features with lines indicating age. Both figures are depicted in formal attire from a period-style manner. There is printed text above and below the illustration.
